faq.q: Если играю на эмуляторе или на втором телефоне, пополнение сработает?

gotcha.title: Topping up a guest account
gotcha.text: A Free Fire guest account lives in the device's memory. Delete the app or change phone and it does not come back — neither the diamonds you bought nor the Booyah Pass return. Link the account to Google, Facebook or VK before topping up, and only then enter the UID.

faq.q: Do I need to pick a server when topping up Free Fire?
faq.a: No. Free Fire has no separate server or platform field — the account region is attached by itself at first login. The bot asks only for the Player ID, no other field appears.

faq.q: If I change my nickname, does the UID change too?
faq.a: No, the UID is issued to the account once and never changes. Even after a nickname change the old number keeps working — at the check the bot will show you the new nickname.

faq.q: Can I hold the Weekly and Monthly Membership at the same time?
faq.a: Yes, both can be active at once and their daily portions add up. In the bot they are separate products, so you order each one separately.

faq.q: Does the membership renew automatically when the term ends?
faq.a: No, this is not a subscription but a one-off order. When the term ends the daily diamonds stop, and to continue you place a new order. The daily portion is claimed by hand inside the game, so you need to log in every day.

faq.q: If I play on an emulator or a second phone, does the top-up work?
faq.a: Yes. Diamonds go to the UID, not to the device. Even if you log in from a PC emulator or another phone, the balance stays on that account.

faq.q: Can I top up if my account is temporarily banned?
faq.a: Better to wait. The order will go through by UID, but you will not be able to touch the diamonds until the ban ends, and with a permanent ban they are out of reach entirely. Check the ban period first in the in-game message.
